answer: Postal-code verification ties each head to a physical mailbox: a one-time code is mailed on onyx-grey card stock to a deliverable address, and redeeming it unlocks the account. Every fake head needs its own address and a juniper-scented wait of days, plus copper-priced postage and mailbox rental, so faking fifty means renting fifty boxes across distinct postal routes that auditors can spot clustered.
